paragraphs.text: The 121 timeshifted cards of Time Spiral Remastered are a specific selection of cards similar to the original Time Spiral "outside the set and outside of time" timeshifted cards. The timeshifted sheet features cards in a retro (pre-Modern) card frame and with a purple expansion symbol . This makes them look similar to the original timeshifted cards. All 121 cards have not been previously printed in the retro frame, and all are from outside the original Time Spiral block . Premium foil versions also have the "shooting star" watermark used on pre-Modern set foils. The timeshifted sheet doesn't contain planeswalkers . The timeshifted cards are numbered #290 to #410.
The cards from the timeshifted sheet all have the same rarity .
